Implemented the banner simplification.

Changed [plugins/pantoken/custom-components/src/components/banner/banner.css](plugins/pantoken/custom-components/src/components/banner/banner.css) so:

- the banner border uses `--instui-component-banner-border-color`
- only unmodified direct-child buttons get the primary on-color treatment
- an unmodified sibling button gets `background-color: transparent`
- `-color-secondary` and other modifier-specific overrides were removed, so user-supplied modifiers can apply normally

Updated the assertions in [plugins/pantoken/custom-components/tests/index.test.ts](plugins/pantoken/custom-components/tests/index.test.ts), regenerated the custom-components artifacts, and added [`.changeset/banner-button-defaults.md`](.changeset/banner-button-defaults.md).
